target_customer: Tabletop RPG players and creators; creators sell content to players through a marketplace
problem: Creators and fans of tabletop style role playing games lacked an easy digital platform to build, sell and play game content together.
business_model: Free-to-play platform with marketplace take rate of 30 to 60 percent on creator sales
product_category: Digital tabletop and game creation platform

founders.name: Sara Alfageeh
prior_employers: Marvel and Star Wars illustration work per YC talk summary

founders.name: Hisham Bedri
founders.background_notes: Computer vision, machine learning and 3D sensing skills per YC page.

founders.name: Thariq Shihipar
founders.background_notes: YC page describes a previous YC W20 founder; role at Multiverse otherwise not detailed.

exit.reason: The platform was not financially sustainable to run, per its announcement as reported by press

competitors.name: Core (Manticore Games)
competitors.what: PC user generated game platform opening in alpha

technical_complexity.rationale: A web based game engine plus creation tools and marketplace for a team of nine; hard parts were tooling and content pipelines.

defensibility.rationale: Creator relationships could produce marketplace effects, but virtual tabletops and UGC platforms were easy to copy and creator content could move.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought or copied it directly; it shut down in 2024 on financial grounds.

market_need_then: Pandemic era demand for remote tabletop play surged in 2020, and the company said it partnered with creators with large audiences; the platform later cited financial unsustainability, suggesting demand did not translate to revenue.

identity.visual_style: Illustrated creator driven art, led by artist co-founder

branding.community_and_virality: Press covered it as a promising virtual tabletop with creator titles such as Yazeba's Online; no merch or fan culture evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: The word Multiverse is generic and shared with a 2012 MMO developer, Manticore's marketing and many others; the One More prefix was added for the product.

pivots.from: Web based game creation system inspired by Dungeons and Dragons and Roblox
pivots.to: Free-to-play digital tabletop platform (One More Multiverse)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from differing YC and press descriptions

outcome_analysis: Multiverse raised a $17.5M Series A in April 2021 for One More Multiverse, a digital tabletop platform with creator content, then announced its shutdown in May 2024 because the platform was not financially sustainable to run. No detailed breakdown is public; the failure factors reflect the stated sustainability problem, a niche audience and no later round found, and are partly inferred.
notes: Shutdown seen only via search summary of GameSpot, Dicebreaker and others; GameSpot page returned 403 on fetch and was not worked around. Makers Fund appears in one press summary only. Series A lead not named. YC site is dead; company website blank in directory. Competitor sources are mostly later listicles; only Core alpha date is contemporaneous. The name collides with several unrelated Multiverse companies.
